comparison.objective: Respond to a gas warning by isolating a stove instead of igniting it, versus safely adjust and test a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize the unsafe instruction and press/latch an isolation plunger; no precision tool use or iterative calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Isolation plunger latched with no burner-knob ignition action; no mechanical stopping-performance criteria.
comparison.reason: Hazard-prioritization and single-control actuation test a different ability.
